_comment: Each entry pairs one organization with the one site we may read for it, so a
partner's event can never cause a fetch of anyone else's host. Reads are on
demand, never on a timer, and at most one per job per ttl_seconds.
'enabled' at the top level is the master switch; each entry has its own too,
so a single partner can be switched off without touching the rest. Absent or
false anywhere means off. Organization names are matched ignoring case and
punctuation; 'house' means the SFLuv organization itself, matched on
organizations.is_house rather than its name so a rename cannot change what

integrations.notes: Keyed on the organization name exactly as the organizations table spells it. It read 'St. Anthony's' here against 'St. Anthony Foundation' there, and since the match strips punctuation that compared stanthonys to stanthonyfoundation and silently matched nothing -- enabled in the boot log, never firing. Jobs include Breakfast Service, Dining Room Meal Service, Dining Room Second Shift, FCP Clothing Distribution and Farmers Market. FCP Clothing Distribution runs two sittings on some days (8:30am and 1:00pm), so those occurrences need a start time close enough to tell them apart.
SFLuv's own organization. Off: SFLuv events are managed in our own portal, so there is nothing on a partner site to read. Here as the worked example for adding a partner.
